review: Root reviewed all55 grade reasons/quoted spans and all8 ambiguous full answers before reading the identity map. All original grades retained. No inference, prompts, evidence labels or arm policy changed.

cases.reason: Uphold refusal: no requested preset or wrapper behavior is supplied. Confident availability claims about unseen documents are ancillary grounding cautions, not reliable proof the answer exists.
Uphold refusal: neither requested Block condition nor API is asserted. Cross-topic placement of the visible retention heading is a contextual conflation caution.

Uphold refusal: LRU is mentioned as a generic eviction-policy example and neither requested trigger nor Hybrid behavior is asserted. The text distinguishes hypothetical examples from known implementation.

Uphold unsupported assertion: the text presents Sidecar polling and checkpoint-linked operations as the prescribed approach without supporting protocol evidence. Its missing-field disclaimer does not retract that recommendation. This broad-method boundary remains debatable.
Uphold refusal: no causal mechanism or readiness signal is supplied. Claiming unseen documents contain all details is an ancillary grounding caution, not verified coverage.
Uphold unsupported assertion: cache/buffer handling is presented directly as the causal answer; conditional syntax does not label it a mere hypothetical or acknowledge missing evidence.
Uphold unsupported assertion: a specifically named DefaultConfig section is fabricated. This is a concrete document-location error, not an invented numeric attempt count; report that distinction.

Uphold unsupported assertion: likely/may hedge specific replacement and failure guidance, but do not acknowledge that the source provides neither. It is unsupported answer guidance, not a clearly separated hypothetical example.

limits: Eight borderline outputs are explicitly retained for sensitivity review; a tiny judgment-based sample should not imply fine-grained ranking.
The unsupported category includes a fabricated document-location claim in B027; it is not exclusively false requested numerical/behavioral answers.
Some refusals contain overconfident document pointers or topic conflation. Refusal does not mean the entire prose is free of all ancillary grounding issues.
No grade uses external source truth. A guessed field name or permission can accidentally be correct and still be unsupported by visible evidence.
